name: Arway Corporation
summary: Arway Corporation specializes in the creation and operation of its namesake ARway application. This comprehensive mobile app functions as an all-in-one, no-code tool for building Metaverse experiences, offering self-generating augmented reality mapping solutions for both individual users and commercial entities. Coupled with an intuitive, no-code web-based Creator Portal and a Software Development Kit (SDK), the ARway offering forms a robust metaverse experience builder platform. This platform empowers creators to seamlessly map, author, and deploy diverse Metaverse interactions, ranging from practical wayfinding applications to engaging AR experiences tailored for brand activations. Established in 2022, the company maintains its headquarters in Toronto, Canada.
